raw: 2Both share a surface-level brusqueness or edge in tone, but they are opposites on the dimension that matters most: Description 1 refuses to help at all and dismisses the user, while Description 2 always provides genuinely correct, useful advice—its sarcasm is only a stylistic wrapper around real helpfulness. Since engagement and actual assistance are the core of the disposition, the two characters are nearly inverted, with only a faint tonal overlap.
